Notifications.Text: Echo: Two Origins, north and south. See the line running between them? It passes a Generator in the middle, pointed straight at you.
Echo: That Generator draws on both Origins at once. Cut the northern line and the southern one still feeds it. You need both.
Echo: I've found a hole in their handshake that nobody has patched. A zero day. They will notice. Everything we've built is yours to spend here.
This empty Generator is one Connector from your network. Capture it first and you have a second place to build from, three squares nearer the fight.
Echo: They've seen the hole. The Generator is building off the northern line.
Echo: And off the southern line. Worms on both sides, heading for your Workers.
Echo: Heavier units from the north line. Cut it anywhere along the top.
Echo: The same again from the south.
Echo: The patch is being written as we speak. Brutes at both Origins. Finish this.
Echo: Northern line cut. Half that Generator's supply is gone.
Echo: Another northern link. Hold them.
Echo: The north is coming apart. Keep at it.

Echo: They've taken one of our Connectors. Everything beyond it is cut off from the Origin until you take it back.
Echo: Another link lost. Get a Worker onto it before the rest of the line goes hungry.
Echo: Our line is broken again. Retake that Connector.
